  ┌─ keyboard shortcuts ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐  
  │ in the task list                                                                         │  
  │ ↑ / k         select previous task                                                       │  
  │ ↓ / j         select next task                                                           │  
  │ ←             previous view                                                              │  
  │ →             next view                                                                  │  
  │ 1-6           jump to view                                                               │  
  │ alt-↑ / alt-k Move up                                                                    │  
  │ alt-↓ / alt-j Move down                                                                  │  
  │ >             Indent                                                                     │  
  │ <             Outdent                                                                    │  
  │ h             collapse subtree (again: to parent)                                        │  
  │ l             expand subtree                                                             │  
  │ H             collapse all subtrees                                                      │  
  │ L             expand all subtrees                                                        │  
  │ return        open / close task details                                                  │  
  │ c             complete selected task                                                     │  
  │ ── 16/106 · ↑↓ scroll ──                                                                 │
